title: Revenge Hub
features:
Features

+ Farm Tab
* Auto Collect Arrows
* Auto Stand

+ Raid Tab
* Raid Farm
* Raid Auto Retry

+ Styles / Races (Soon) Tab
* Switch to boxing / karate / hamon / kendo styles

+ Player Tab
* Walkspeed changer
* Jump Power changer
* Hip Height (character height) changer
* Noclip

+ Teleport Tab
* TP to mission boards
* TP to quest marker
* TP to world event
* TP to saved position
* TP to mini bosses
* TP to gang locations
* Various map/npc tp

+ Misc / Settings
* Anti Afk
* Admin script (inf yield)
* Server hop
* Rejoin this server
* Copy job id, join by job id
* Keybind to open UI (You can change it)
* UI Theme
